1_raft: GAME TITLE LOGO built like a river RAFT: every letter of CAPYVERSE is constructed from round driftwood sticks and branches of different thickness, sun-bleached caramel and honey-brown, lashed together at the joints with wrapped hemp rope and little knots; curves of C, P, R, S made from bent green-brown twigs. ODYSSEY is made of thin twigs tied onto a single long horizontal driftwood pole underneath, rope loops connecting the two rows. The text reads EXACTLY "CAPYVERSE" on the first line and "ODYSSEY" on the second line, correctly spelled letter by letter, no other words. CAPYVERSE big and dominant, ODYSSEY smaller and tucked close beneath. Material: BROWN WOOD in warm natural tones (honey, caramel, walnut), rich but not muddy. NO stars, NO emblems, NO plaque or board behind the whole logo, NO characters, NO animals, NO icons, NO scenery. A thin clean cream keyline around the whole logo. Front view, centered on a plain flat light grey background with wide margin, soft even light. Quirky, characterful, hand-made indie PC game title with real craft and personality; letters slightly irregular and bouncy. NOT a mobile game logo, NOT bubble letters, NOT generic carved fantasy wood.
